title: P. J. Tucker
wikitext:
'''P.J. Tucker''' is a basketball player for the [[University of Texas]]. In his 3 seasons at Texas, he has scored 1169 points, including a career high 594 in the 2005-2006 season. He is also a great rebounder, having collected 714 rebounds. He could become just one of a handful of players to have scored 1500 points and collected 1000 rebounds. He also shares the basketball very well, having dished out 170 assists, including 107 in 2005-2006. He is also capable of steals, having posted 116 steals throughout his career.
